notes:
Account profile: Onboardly builds in-app guided onboarding copilots for B2B SaaS apps (tour + contextual help + task automation). Mid-market buyer (product-led with sales overlay). Primary metric = onboarding completion rate and time-to-value; token spend per session is a hard constraint.

Conversation highlights:
- "We need streaming responses that feel instant — users drop off after 400ms perceived lag" — Head of Product.
- Interested in tool-calling so copilot can run account-creation steps and fetch user metadata; worried about chain-of-calls latency.
- Wants a deterministic token cap per session and predictable monthly spend (asks: can Redwood enforce per-session token limits + early truncation policy?).

Technical constraints: 300-500 peak concurrent onboarding sessions per customer, average session ~120 tokens, burst to 2k concurrency during promos. Latency SLO target: 95th <= 350ms for first-stream chunk, total response < 800ms for multi-step tool calls. Cost sensitivity: looking to optimize with batching + prefix caching; inclined to explore quantized model variants if quality remains ok.

Procurement/security: SSO + SCIM required, audit logs retention 1 year, customer wants EU data residency for EU customers. Legal flagged data residency + retention for review.

Sales notes / tactics: position hosted API for fast time-to-value and try a short hosted POC (48h perf run) to validate streaming SLOs. If hosted meets SLOs, move to Dedicated conversation: committed throughput + reserved pricing to hit cost caps. Prepare a short appendix comparing expected token-unit costs (hosted vs dedicated) for their projected QPS.
